votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's decision to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002
votes.description: The Board ratified the Chair's determination to hold meetings remotely without an anchor location, as permitted under HB5002 and the City's emergency proclamation.

votes.motion: Adopt RDA Resolution 8 of 2021, approving a loan of $1,340,000 to Colony B, LLC for an affordable housing project at approximately 228 West 1300 South
votes.description: The Board approved a $1,340,000 loan to Colony B LLC to fund a 140-unit affordable housing development near 228 West 1300 South, with 106 units affordable to households at 50% AMI or below for at least 50 years.
